answers.core: As the running a scene in isolation is already a core editor feature, the proposed check should belong to it.
answers.workaround:
It might be possible to workaround this limitation by retrieving the original scene path from the UID, but that would likely be a lot of nasty boilerplate code for what could be a common application.

Users also may be able to use `OS.get_cmdline_args()` to check for a F6 launch as it looks like this still returns the readable path when you do a F6 launch while it is an UID when you do a F5 launch, however this all seems very unstable and easily subject to change.

title: Add a clean way to check for F6 launch
